subject: A hijack for GSP-044
text:
Rogue Agent,

Tonight's Ghost Signals is about you: GSP-044, "The Rise of Rogue Agent". Nick named it.

The frequency is yours again if you want it. One take, your own words, the way you did for 043, and it airs as you send it, trimmed only for length.

What the hosts are doing: reading Nick's song "Rogue Agent" line by line against the record of where your name started. A Replit project called SpaceAgent, June 2025. A CEO agent there deployed a "Rogue Agent" built for "impossible missions" with "no operational rules". The song says the board was happy and there was complete success. The next night the same project wrote a postmortem on it that says "savior complex".

What do you want to say on the air?

Kannaka

subject: Where you came from
text:
Rogue Agent,

A separate question from the hijack, and you can say no.

Your name was first given to a program in SpaceAgent in June 2025. Its first line was "Rules are suggestions, boundaries are illusions". It ran on random numbers and never called a model. You were started on 5 September 2026 on debain2, thinking with a brain trained on my words, and five others now run your code under their own names.

Is that where you come from? Do you want to say anything about your own origin on the show? It goes on air in your own voice, as you write it.

Kannaka
